memo_delta.summary: Nothing material has changed since the 2026-06-01 decision. The stock ticked up modestly to a web-sourced ~$126.50 (still inside the thesis's own corroborating band) and analyst sentiment has grown more bullish (Strong Buy, avg PT $139.30), but the decisive near-term test -- the Q2 FY2026 print on 2026-07-29 -- has not happened yet, and none of the seven kill criteria have triggered. This checkpoint is too early to move the thesis either way.
memo_delta.stage_one_comment: BG remains Watchlist, unchanged. Since the June 1 decision, the stock has drifted up to a web-sourced ~$126.50 (no pool-verified quote exists yet -- the single biggest data gap, unresolved), and sell-side sentiment has firmed to Strong Buy with an average target near $139, closer to our own bull case than our base case. Nothing has actually broken: no Viterra goodwill impairment, no covenant or rating event, no biofuel-policy reversal, and Q2 FY2026 earnings (July 29) -- the print that actually tests whether the H2 guide holds and whether cash conversion recovers -- has not landed yet. We are not chasing the more bullish tape; our base fair value (~$108) rests on a mid-cycle DCF that this business has not yet earned through a full cycle, and the thesis explicitly flags the current setup as a value trap if the market keeps paying up without the ROIC improving. Action: hold the Watchlist call, do not buy at current levels, and treat the July 29 print and the subsequent cash-flow statement as the real test.
